data.text: I think there's 3 things you should still add. Obviously, the first is covering up those gaps on the side in some way, so someone can't just look in from there. The second would be a simple popout mechanism on the left side so that you have a handle there too - might make it a little easier to open. And finally, an unlinked locking mechanism from the inside so you can lock yourself in there if you dont want to be disturbed while you read :p

100% take this idea, improve on it, and create an even more intricate and more beautiful door to leave for the landlord. The guy seems like an amazing person. This door you made is yours, it's your first creation of its kind and I understand why you want to keep it, but yeah... just make a new one for him.
You should get someone to paint a hexagonal mosaic on the door to make it look like an art piece then there can be specific hints on where to press using the painting.

This was amazing to watch. If you’re planning to invest more time in upgrading the mechanism, I would love to see a motorized version of the door or a sliding mechanism that is in sync with the rotating hexagon that opens the door instead of manually sliding the two sides apart. Happy new year! 🎉
